identification.summary: ELOQUENT PANDA is a name listed in the MISP Galaxy adversary-groups data with country code CN (China) and no descriptive text [S1]. The name follows the CrowdStrike 'Panda' convention for China-nexus adversaries, and the MISP entry cites a CrowdStrike presentation titled 'Detecting and Responding: Pandas and Bears' [S1]. No vendor profile, malware, targeting or campaign reporting was found in open searches.
identification.notes: Search-result summaries of the Malpedia 'Union Panda' entry mention Eloquent Panda as a related name alongside Union Panda, with the same CrowdStrike presentation as reference; the synonym field itself could not be confirmed [S2]. This record could not be confirmed by fetching Malpedia directly. Do not merge any facts from Union Panda, Emissary Panda or Evasive Panda into this record without a source that states the link.

attribution.basis: MISP Galaxy tags the name with country CN only; no source gathered states a sponsoring organization [S1].

gaps: No open-source report was found that describes ELOQUENT PANDA's activity, tooling, victims or infrastructure.
The CrowdStrike presentation 'Detecting and Responding: Pandas and Bears' (cited by MISP) could not be opened (the dokumen.tips host did not resolve), so its content and date are unverified [S1].
Possible synonymy with Union Panda (per a Malpedia listing seen only in search results) is unverified; Malpedia could not be fetched [S2].
CrowdStrike's own adversary page for this name was not found; origin of the name, first-observed date and sponsor are unknown.
No Microsoft name mapping or MITRE group ID is known for this name.
